response.summary: Every open-question row in 002 to 008 appears in the sweep, the run table matches the phase records, and the close record leaves PR and acceptance pending as it should. Ten concerns remain. (1) Part D's review input was quietly narrowed: the record's description drops the milestone diff the close plan committed to, and some IL1/IL2 code has never had any review. (2) Three dispositions say fixed or discharged but leave residuals out: IL4-Q1's own-reference subtypes and IL1-Q3's out-of-set values. (3) Some verdicts overstate their evidence: predicate 1 omits the dropped learner-mismatch check, predicate 7 overstates review coverage, and IL5 omits the unreported version. (4) Two plan repairs are incomplete or untagged: IL6-C1 still says every adapter runs on refunds, and the status line has no (c) tag and contradicts section 8. response.summary: Found multiple instances where close repairs (c) changed the approved criterion's intent (altering required learner types, comparison fixtures, and metrics), leading to incorrect 'MET' verdicts in the close record.

evidence.observation: The verdict reads "MET (FastLAS not kept, IL2-D1)" citing `003`. But record 003 (`003-phase-IL2.md`) never mentions FastLAS anywhere; its only explicit reference to IL2-D1 is the licence ruling: "the licence was recorded (spec §12) and ruled (IL2-D1)" and "ILASP is used for non-commercial research by the owner's ruling (IL2-D1)". The keep/drop decision for FastLAS is at most among the spec §13 gate rulings IL2-D1..D11, which the record does not restate, so the parenthetical verdict is unsupported by the record it cites (the ILASP half of the predicate is fully supported).

concerns.recommendation: Cite the artifact that records the FastLAS disposition (e.g. the phase-IL2 spec's gate section or a 003 line naming it), or soften the parenthetical to note the ruling is recorded outside the cited record.

response.summary: The close record's completion-predicate verdicts, question sweep, and part A/B commitments are supported by records 002-008 and the close repairs; parts D and E are honestly pending. Completion predicate 1 still reads "**Compatibility:** every IK5, IK6 and RF1 golden stays byte-identical, except where D12's join check refuses a clause (p1)" while the repaired section 9 IL1 row (line 668) reads "goldens unchanged except the C2 cases and the IK5 goldens named by the owner-recorded amendments (c)" -- and record 002 shows the owner amendments did move IK5 goldens (the X1 Popper export tree, expected.json, 19 run-record export_sha256 fields). Section 4's IL6-C1 still reads "the walk replays every adapter's committed run of record over the IK6 refunds example" while the repaired goal item 6 (lines 109-111) reads "runs the labelled adapters on the IK6 refunds example, and `amie` on the committed staffing fixture, which has the relations a miner needs (c)" -- so the plan now states the IL6 walk criterion two contradictory ways, and IL6-C1 as written was not met for amie. The close record's verdicts "plan repaired" (predicate 1) and "the walk's wording repaired (IL4-Q5)" (predicate 6) therefore point at partial repairs.

response.summary: All three artifacts hash-match the request. Cross-checked against records 002-008: the close record's question sweep covers every open-question row (IL1-Q1..Q7, IL2-Q1..Q4, IL5-Q1..Q6, IL3-Q1..Q4, IL4-Q1..Q5, IL6-Q1..Q3, 007's refactoring deferral, ILC-F5/F6, IL-close-Q1) exactly once, and every 'fixed'/'discharged' claim traces to the cited record (008 C1-C9 for the fixes; live_common in 005, binds in 004, unlabelled-horn in 006, AMIE invocation 2 in 007 for the discharges). The completion-predicate verdicts are supported, with residuals disclosed rather than hidden; the PR list matches the milestone README; Part A-E commitments are met or honestly marked pending (part D review, PR, owner acceptance); the boundary section averts overstatement of reproducibility, learner quality and acceptance. Two non-blocking wording-consistency concerns remain.

criteria: Judge whether the close record's completion-predicate verdicts are supported by the phase records it cites (002 to 008 in the same directory); cite the record line for any verdict you dispute.
Check that every open-question row in records 002 to 008 has exactly one disposition in the close record's sweep, and that each 'fixed' or 'discharged' claim is supported by the cited record.
Check that the plan's close repairs, tagged (c), only record what happened and change no approved criterion's intent; flag any that does.
Check that the close plan's Part A to E commitments are met or honestly marked pending in the close record.
Flag any claim in the close record that overstates evidence, such as reproducibility, learner quality or acceptance.
Cite one concrete artifact location for every concern, and mark each concern blocking or non-blocking for closing the milestone.
